title: Serve all 384 nonunit denominator-52 tails with one reversible circuit
body:
**One fixed reversible circuit now covers the 288 mixed and 96 endpoint denominator-52 tails excluded from the existing nonzero-pair core.** It uses **1,277 gates and 382 clean work bits per draw**, with the original ordered output labels, live-node index and stopping depth. This answers the released tail-controller question in [PR #7757](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7757). **No new kappa** or complete physical sampler is claimed.

Read the [proof and contract](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/2a79ceb497c8b76a44cd3a9f706becdf9bbb8b7a/research/nonunit52-tail-circuit/PROOF.md), [circuit and actual source recipes](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/2a79ceb497c8b76a44cd3a9f706becdf9bbb8b7a/research/nonunit52-tail-circuit/tail.py), [complete bill and certificates](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/2a79ceb497c8b76a44cd3a9f706becdf9bbb8b7a/research/nonunit52-tail-circuit/RESULT.json), [checker](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/2a79ceb497c8b76a44cd3a9f706becdf9bbb8b7a/research/nonunit52-tail-circuit/verify.py), [19 source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/2a79ceb497c8b76a44cd3a9f706becdf9bbb8b7a/research/nonunit52-tail-circuit/SOURCE-PINS.json) and [credits](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/2a79ceb497c8b76a44cd3a9f706becdf9bbb8b7a/research/nonunit52-tail-circuit/CREDITS.md).

After the four-coin prefix, a mixed tail reduces to two complementary pairs over denominator thirteen, with two live nodes at every phase. An endpoint tail has one complementary pair and one live node. Runtime residues `u,v`, orientation and mode are read-only. The circuit computes both probability digits, orders the column-pair leaves, updates the phase and applies an explicit inverse. Packet copying, swaps and all uncomputation are included.

| Resource per tail draw | Count |
| --- | ---: |
| X / CNOT / Toffoli gates | 70 / 895 / 312 |
| Total gates | 1,277 |
| Temporary work + clean packet backing | 375 + 7 = 382 bits |
| Live packet / parameter bits / resident coin | 7 / 10 / 1 |
| Complete runtime transitions | 576 parameter settings; 20,736 edges |

All runtime edges pass forward and inverse checks on every wire. A separate scalar interpreter checks 1,152 cases both ways. All 169 modular additions and their reversal pass. Five gate controls detect changed stopping, parameter, mode, work state and output order. All 384 actual bounded owner witnesses and 16,128 ordered source-tail edges agree with a direct denominator-2,704 floor calculation. The original fixed-pair arithmetic verifier runs unchanged.

Python 3.12, standard library only:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/nonunit52-tail-circuit
```

Both registered commands print:

```text
PASS_NONUNIT52_TAIL_CIRCUIT
288 mixed and 96 endpoint source pairs; 16128 exact source-tail edges
576 runtime parameter graphs; 20736 full forward/inverse transitions
70 X; 895 CNOT; 312 Toffoli; 1277 gates; 375 temporary + 7 backing = 382 clean bits
```

Normal and optimized registered replay, syntax/indentation, committed bytes/source history/modes, export and sealed read-only Git-free serial replay pass. Hosted CI did not certify this package. The [plan job](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44427989589/job/135237712536) failed in the shared `test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record`: the base guide names frontier6030 while the selected record requires `make frontier7000-verify`. The log reports 760 tests, one failure and 24 skipped; package replay was skipped. This package changes no shared CI file. Local replay remains the scientific evidence.

Nick Petalas (@petalas) supplied the unchanged [Boolean primitives](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/blob/71fdb2cf1ec973b5402c4d3c2466864014a1ccda/research/paired-ddg-arithmetic-step/circuit.py), clean-oracle method and [fixed-pair verifier](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/blob/71fdb2cf1ec973b5402c4d3c2466864014a1ccda/research/paired-ddg-arithmetic-step/verify.py) in [PR #7746](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7746). The subclass uses the unchanged primitives with its explicit wire layout; no retained function or global is patched. @JoyboyBrian supplied the [actual residue-domain proof](https://github.com/JoyboyBrian/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e56f5094c83f3e514d9936fa7b1c8027745a0a00/research/inverse-residue-domain/README.md), [owner constructor](https://github.com/JoyboyBrian/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e56f5094c83f3e514d9936fa7b1c8027745a0a00/research/inverse-residue-domain/verify.py) and [mode columns](https://github.com/JoyboyBrian/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e56f5094c83f3e514d9936fa7b1c8027745a0a00/research/coded-native-caller/NORMALIZERS.json) in [PR #6096](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6096).

Ali Romman (@aliromman), with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, supplied the [entry classification and boundary proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/5640f56b63ea04afc8505d45a4df1ea35466a94e/research/inverse52-phase-entry/PROOF.md), [interface](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/5640f56b63ea04afc8505d45a4df1ea35466a94e/research/inverse52-phase-entry/interface.py) and the [PR7755 interpreter framework](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/d6babec41a3d01928c3dbdb896ea2adf051ba305/research/runtime-paired-ddg-arithmetic/verify.py). @zxv supplied the ordered paired graph and [probability proof](https://github.com/zxv/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9011bf83e85ecd0443c789cf03259442f750877d/research/paired-residue-sampler/README.md) in [PR #6072](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6072). All retained notices preserve the inverse, normalizer, coded-producer and lifecycle lineage.

Mixed tail weights sum to two and represent two entry nodes; they are not a fresh one-root probability law. The circuit's cyclic inverse does not implement the first prefix return. Worst-case stopping remains unbounded. With fresh fair coins, endpoint entries average two tail coins; mixed nodes zero and one average one and three, respectively. These are conditional coin counts, not a physical caller bill.

Parameter preparation, prefix execution and return, physical wire/tape movement, output retention, stopping storage, conditional freshness and the complete native invoice remain open. The full inverse kernel fixtures, complete PR7757 verifier, full PR7755 runtime verifier, historical probability/mean catalogue, selected cold replay, Lean and Docker were not run. The larger generic circuit accepts a different domain; no matched physical speedup or global gate optimum is claimed. All five assumptions and the selected frontier remain unchanged.

Base: canonical main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`, priority revision 8. The source pins identify every consumed head; no unmerged ancestry is asserted. Prepared by Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in research, implementation, verification and writing. Apache-2.0. No independent human or formal-kernel acceptance is claimed. [Canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/6073#discussioncomment-19721779).
